ARVORE.Guia.passo.jogador1: Here you see your character's Skill Trees. At the top are the open tree, your character and how many points you have.
ARVORE.Guia.passo.jogador2: Click an ability to see what it does and what it needs. The ones glowing green are available: use Unlock in the panel. Some need training: you pay and it is ready after a few long rests.
ARVORE.Guia.passo.jogador3: Plan shows the cost of a path before you spend. Refund several returns abilities, if the GM allows. The sheet also has a Skill Tree tab. The ? button opens this guide again.
ARVORE.Guia.passo.mestre1: Here you build skill trees for characters to buy with Skill Points, XP, Gold or resources you create yourself. At the top are the sections, the open Skill Tree and the character you are viewing.
ARVORE.Guia.passo.mestre2: In the lower strip, + Skill Tree creates a tree and This Skill Tree sets costs, rules and look. Click Edit to build on the map: New creates an ability and Shift+click on one and then another links the two.
ARVORE.Guia.passo.mestre3: Assign chooses who gets the tree. The Table shows every character, gives rewards, Great Deeds and applies trees to NPCs. Made a mistake? The Table has Undo.
ARVORE.Guia.passo.mestre4: Check points out problems in the tree and Statistics shows how much it costs to take everything. The palette changes the color theme. General holds the backup and Reset Trees. The ? button opens this guide again.
